name: Canva
price: Free; Pro US$144/yr (about US$12/mo, annual billing); Business US$250/yr per person
watermark: No watermark on standard free exports; premium assets require Pro
bestFor: Template-led social videos and graphics, especially on iPhone
notFor: Frame-accurate multi-track editing or long-form video projects
limits: Free: 5GB cloud storage, 4.7M+ free assets, 1.6M+ templates, and 1 brand kit with 3 colors. Premium templates and stock media require Pro.
